The 2014 UPU sheet and current BPS address guide establish the five-digit locality form, while the December 2024 Government launch states that the parish character is removed from the six-character BBID and the remaining five characters are appended to the old postcode. Minimise household queries and retain terms, purpose, observed_at, validity, service version and digests. AGID remains an independent versioned spatial crosswalk.
